headline.purpose: The current upload or analysis state.

motion.name: state-duration
motion.purpose: Action and media state transitions; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Analysis Button
components.description: The decisive file selection or photograph-analysis action.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 18px; padding: 12px 16px 12px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #252521; color: #f4f2ed; font-family: 'Neue Haas Grotesk Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-primary-button:hover { background: #3b3a35; } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5d5b55; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary-button:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Quiet Replace Button
components.description: A secondary text action for replacing the selected photo or cancelling a request.
components.css: .ds-quiet-button { min-height: 44px; display: block; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 2px 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #706e67; font-family: 'Neue Haas Grotesk Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.3; text-align: left; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease, text-decoration-color 160ms ease; } .ds-quiet-button:hover { color: #252521; text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-quiet-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5d5b55; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Photograph Dropzone
components.description: The large image field that accepts a local file and becomes the static preview anchor.
components.css: .ds-dropzone { width: 100%; min-height: 440px; height: min(56vh, 560px); display: grid; place-content: center; gap: 13px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d6d3cb; border-radius: 16px; background: #eceae4; color: #252521; font-family: 'Neue Haas Grotesk Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-dropzone svg { width: 35px; height: 35px; justify-self: center; fill: none; stroke: #706e67; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-width: 1.15; } .ds-dropzone:hover { border-color: #252521; transform: scale(1.015); } .ds-dropzone:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5d5b55; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Workbench Header
components.description: A minimal return path with the Snapgrade wordmark only.
components.css: .ds-header { height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding-inline: clamp(24px, 5vw, 64px); border-bottom: 1px solid #d6d3cb; background: #f4f2ed; } .ds-wordmark { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: #252521; font-family: 'Neue Haas Grotesk Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5d5b55; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: This is the separate upload surface, not the landing page or legacy results UI: a quiet, neutral workspace that makes one photograph the object of attention. The canvas and minimal 64px wordmark header leave the process feeling deliberate rather than promotional. The image area is the static visual anchor; controls sit asymmetrically to its right until the mobile layout stacks them. A local preview always precedes the explicit analysis action.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral paper canvas, dark ink, and restrained structural lines.
One large framed photograph field and terse action copy.
Calm state changes rather than decorative movement.

rules.name: The Quiet Canvas Rule
rules.body: Keep most of the screen in canvas and surface tones; ink is for legibility, decisive actions, and active drag feedback.

dos: Do keep `NEW ANALYSIS` visible above the work area.
Do require a real local preview before exposing the analysis decision.
Do preserve the image-left/actions-right desktop asymmetry and the mobile stack.
Do respect reduced-motion settings by removing state transitions, scaling, and spinner animation.
donts: Don't fold landing-page marketing or legacy result-view styling into this workbench.
Don't add dashboard cards, shadows, or competing color accents around the photograph.
Don't show photo dimensions or file size in the compact mobile layout.
